answer: Because selection is random and the gale seed is unrevealed until close, someone cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a tide gamble with a negative expected value. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 17% of its standing plus a seat ban. The spiral log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
